newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends slightly softer versus dollar.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends slightly softer versus dollar.

text.p: 1500 GMT - The Swiss franc was softer at the close of European trade in quiet activity with the Swiss currency little changed on the day versus both the dollar and the mark.

News the Swiss National Bank left rates unchanged had little impact. Markets are waiting for the U.S. FOMC meeting next Tuesday. Dollar/Swiss failed to break above the highs seen Wednesday of 1.2478, its highest levels since mid-July.
* Dollar ends at 1.2410/15 Swiss francs vs 1.2398/2404 at Wednesday's close.
* Mark ends at 82.07/09 Swiss centimes compared with 82.25/27. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
